descriptionChirho: The proper name שָׁאוּל (Shaul/Saul), referring to (a) King Saul son of Kish, first king of Israel, (b) an Edomite king from Rehoboth on the River (Gen 36:37–38), and (c) Shaul son of Simeon by a Canaanite woman (Gen 46:10); all 15 clusters differ only by prefixed prepositions (ל ,מ) and the conjunction ו, not by meaning.
